formula_identity: For each team, arithmetic mean of per-game ORtg, DRtg, NetRtg and Pace over the last up to 10 completed games strictly before the target game; minimum 3 completed prior games. Then TEAM_A minus TEAM_B for net, pace, offense and defense. IMPORTANT: pregame_games_min preserves the training feature semantics and equals the lesser TOTAL number of completed prior games in the current season, not the rolling-window row count. The rolling window size is tracked separately.
acquisition_query_template: <team full name> last 10 games pace offensive rating defensive rating each game WNBA, plus total completed games before target game
required_checks: all baseline rows are completed games before target game
rolling baseline window contains 3 to 10 rows per team
total prior-games counts are independently recorded and are at least 3
pregame_games_min equals min(total prior games A,total prior games B), preserving fitted-model feature identity
arithmetic mean across returned per-game rows, not provider aggregate shortcut
baseline capture/as-of no more than 36 hours before LIVE state
source URL or provider result identity and content fingerprint recorded
fail_closed: provider returns aggregate only without per-game ORtg/DRtg/Pace rows
rolling-window count or total-prior-game count cannot be verified

legacy_2026_possession_asset.role: verification/replay only after freshness audit; not assumed current for live baseline
